answer: An ivory‑colored reputation ledger acts as an anchor, assigning each agent a reputation score that grows only when the agent stakes a beacon‑linked token for a lock‑up period proportional to its age. Every epoch the ledger decays the score by a fixed rate unless the agent produces verifiable work, so a Sybil must repeat the staking and wait for each fake to mature before it can influence consensus. The attacker therefore pays a cumulative stake of 10 % of network token per identity plus a mandatory 30‑day lock‑up, making large‑scale fake‑identity attacks financially prohibitive.
